question: How should the mandala placed on the right side be worshipped?
premises: The mandala on the right side is the object of worship.
It is worshipped together with its support.
The vidyāṅga weapon mantra is used.
inference: The right-side mandala, with its support, should be worshipped using the vidyāṅga weapon mantra.
uncertainties: The precise meaning of sāśram in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: One should worship the mandala on the right, together with its support, with the vidyāṅga weapon mantra.
